column1: # Epistemic: measured (cumulative distinct ai.onnx operator schema introductions across official ONNX opset releases)
# Method: scripted (counted distinct ai.onnx operator names with earliest since_version <= opset from ONNX schema history paired with GitHub release dates)
# Computation: Count of distinct ai.onnx operators whose earliest since_version <= opset from get_all_schemas_with_history() / docs/Changelog.md.
#   release: string [tag] — Official ONNX GitHub release version introducing the opset
#   date: date [ISO-8601 date] — GitHub release publication date
#   opset: integer [version] — Default ai.onnx operator-set version number introduced in the release
#   operators: integer [operators] — Cumulative count of distinct ai.onnx operators introduced up to and including the opset
# Notes: Date is the GitHub release publication date that introduced each opset.
